I am too old to bend in the field all day, but my children and grandchildren still listen when I tell them how to plant. We will use the government fertilizer we received through the coupon program this season, as we do most years, because without it the maize will not grow tall enough. We also put manure from our goats on the soil before planting, and we use the improved seed that comes with the program, intercropped with pigeon pea as always. We have no money for spraying chemicals or paying workers, and God sends rain to Mangochi every year, so we do not irrigate.
